STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE)
Solicitation No.: SYN-A-0001
Title: Flight-Line Engineering Support Services, Naval Air Station (Notional)

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall provide flight-line engineering support services,
including aircraft turnaround inspection support, flight-line
troubleshooting of avionics and airframe discrepancies, and technical
liaison between flight-line maintenance crews and engineering
disposition authorities.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 The Contractor shall furnish flight-line engineers qualified to
    review discrepancy write-ups and recommend corrective engineering
    dispositions consistent with the applicable Naval Air Training and
    Operating Procedures Standardization (NATOPS) manuals.
2.2 The Contractor shall support time-critical flight-line
    troubleshooting during turnaround operations, including
    engineering judgment calls on airworthiness impact.
2.3 The Contractor shall document all flight-line engineering
    dispositions in the government-furnished maintenance data system.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Flight line and adjacent maintenance hangars, notional Naval Air
Station.
